Executive Order 12322 of September 17, 1981
Water Resources Projects
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and law s of the 
United States of A m erica, and in order to ensure efficient and coordinated 
planning and review  o f w ater resources programs and projects, it is hereby 
ordered a& follow s:
Section 1. Before any agency or officer thereof subm its to the Congress, or to 
any com m ittee or m em ber thereof, for approval, appropriations, or legislative 
action any report, proposal, or plan relating to a Federal or Federally assisted  
w ater and related land resources p roject or program, such report, proposal, or 
plan shall be subm itted to the D irector o f the O ffice o f M anagem ent and 
Budget.
Sec. 2. The Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall examine 
each report, proposal, or plan for consistency with, and shall advise the 
agency of the relationship of the project to, the following:
(a) the policy and programs of the President;
(b) the Principles and Standards for W ater and R elated  Land R esources 
Planning (Part 711 of Title 18 o f the Code o f Fed eral Regulations (45 F.R. 
64366)), or other such planning guidelines for w ater and related land resou rces 
planning, as shall hereafter be issued; and
(c) other applicable law s, regulations, and requirem ents relevant to the plan­
ning process.
Sec. 3. W hen such report, proposal, or plan is thereafter subm itted to the 
Congress, or to any com m ittee or m em ber thereof, it shall include a statem ent 
of the advice received from the O ffice of M anagem ent and Budget.
Sec. 4. Executive O rder No. 12113, as amended, is revoked.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 12322 of September 17, 1981 (46 FR 46561, September 21, 1981) was read in full from the held Federal Register original (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12322.txt, PDF page 11). The order requires agency water resources reports, proposals and plans to be submitted to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget before they go to Congress (section 1), directs the Director to examine them against three criteria (section 2), requires the advice to accompany later submissions to Congress (section 3) and revokes Executive Order 12113 (section 4). The order has no sunset or expiry. Current law: the U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints the order in full, as amended by EO 12608, as a note to 42 U.S.C. 1962, and the bounded eCFR search reports that 43 CFR 404.51 states that Reclamation's Rural Water Supply Program projects are reviewed under Executive Order 12322 to determine whether each project is consistent with the policies and programs of the President. The only later change is EO 12608 section 31 (52 FR 34617), which replaces the Principles and Standards reference in section 2(b); the Federal Register catalog and held-text number searches show no revocation or supersession of EO 12322. Bounded searches read for coverage before use: current-law:usc covers the U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted after that date and on or before 2026-10-14 are not reflected); current-law:ecfr covers the eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML; later-events:ofr_catalog covers Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6942 catalog records (1937 onward) plus operative sentences in 16784 saved order texts. These are machine leads, not independent review; the two-week gap in the U.S. Code edition is disclosed here.
